digest.component_or_area: code-review overlay registration and workflow dispatch
propositions: Concurrency overlay must be registered in OVERLAY_IDS enum to enable base reviewer escalation and auto-generate include_concurrency flag.

Content-triggered token list (Mutex, RwLock, Lock, Semaphore, pthread_, tokio::spawn, sync.WaitGroup, etc.) must be committed to registry.py and scanned on added/removed diff lines to fire concurrency overlay.
Concurrency overlay requires routing entry in criteria_routing.json with advisory posture, 0.95 block_threshold, and blocking_disabled=false.
Code-review.yaml gate must wire code-review-concurrency dispatch in both round_a and round_b batches, gated on include_concurrency flags, following existing overlay dispatch pattern.
Unit tests must verify concurrency fires on corpus-derived hunks (e.g., start_new_session=True added, sync.Mutex removed) and does not fire on async/await-only or context-line-only tokens.
